_meta.source: Mercari prepaid-label rate card / USPS / UPS / FedEx (screenshots collected Aug 2026)
_meta._note: Used by the upcoming weight-based return-cost estimator. Weights are in pounds unless a key ends in 'oz'. 'best' = the discounted prepaid rate shown in black. The calculator does NOT need this file to work today; it is pre-loaded for the next enhancement.

mercari_return_rule._note: On an approved Mercari return, the buyer gets a prepaid label for items up to 50 lbs (actual or dimensional weight). Over 50 lbs the SELLER provides and pays the return label within 3 days or the order is canceled. This is the rule that turns a Mercari return into a shipping loss for heavy-item sellers.

default_suggestion._note: When the weight-estimator ships, default to usps_ground_advantage (the cheapest common option) and let the seller switch carrier. If they don't know the weight, fall back to the 1 lb row (~$7.48) as a honest middle guess and say so.
